name: YITAMOTOR Soft Tri-Fold Tonneau Cover for 2019-2026 Dodge Ram 1500 5.7ft | Soft Tri-folding Truck Bed Cover Pickup Cover Compatible with Dodge Ram 1500 2019-2026 New Body Style 5.7 Feet Bed w/o Rambox
fitment:
2009-2026 Ram 1500 Classic/New body（Only for Crew Cab.)
Fleetside 5.7' Bed without Ram Box
NOTE:
Please measure your truck bed size or contact your dealer to confirm the correct model before ordering.

description:
YITAMOTOR factory brand packaging, Each cover is custom-built to ensure precise compatibility with the 5.7’ bed of 2009-2025 Ram 1500 Classic/New body without Rambox. Made from high-quality, commercial-grade vinyl that will not stretch, fade or crack.
Fitment
2009-2026 Ram 1500 Classic/New body（Only for Crew Cab.)
Fleetside 5.7' Bed without Ram Box
NOTE:
Please measure your truck bed size or contact your dealer to confirm the correct model before ordering.
Cab size does not matter as long as you have the correct model and bed size.
Features
Precisely Fit:
Each cover is custom-built to ensure precise compatibility with the 5.7’
bed of 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026 Ram 1500 New Body Style
without Rambox, Split Tailgate and Bed Track System.
Easy Installation: No tools or drilling required; Upgraded clamps with
adjustable holes allow for an easy installation within 20 minutes; user
friendly design for easy assembly and dis-assembly.
Safety First: Reinforced corner design keeps the cover tight to the
bed; sturdy clamps and buckles with straps protect the cover from
sliding or blowing off while driving.
Better Quality: Made with double layer PVC on the top, structured with
solid alloy in the frame, this back cover is build to last for your
truck.
All season Protection: Features tear resistant, water resistance, high
temperature resistance, no matter where you are or what the weather is
like, we’ve got you covered.
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.

specifications.Material: Double layer pvc on the top, solid alloy structured frame
